svg.title: The Cube — layered architectural vector reconstruction
svg.desc: Manually constructed vector geometry based on the supplied architectural illustration. Three occupied floors, glazed facades, timber panels, furnished interiors, rooftop garden, atrium, solar panels and landscaped plaza. No embedded raster image and no automatic tracing. All structural elements have stable named groups. Fine organic detail is an interpretation of the source.
svg.metadata: Animation: roof; floor-01, floor-02, floor-03; floor-0N-plate; exterior-walls-floor-0N; architectural-details-floor-0N; furniture-floor-0N; people-floor-0N; plants-floor-0N; environmental-details; plants-streetscape; people-streetscape; drawing-sheet; annotations. Floor groups contain their own contents. Coordinates use a common 1536 × 864 viewBox.
